{{Quote|Less tax equals more profit.|Raymas Daal, disguising his motivation for the attack on the sensor array|<ref name="Signal" />}}
'''Raymas Daal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who secretly worked for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Trade Federation agents contracted Daal to [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|disrupt]] a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]] outside the Naboo [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]]. To do so, Daal met with a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in a [[Kwilaan restaurant|restaurant]] in Kwilaan, intending to hire them to deactivate the [[Sensor array/Legends|array]]. Agents from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] followed Daal to the meeting, and when they arrived, he quickly fled, leaving the mercenaries to deal with the agents. The mercenaries deactivated the array the following [[Standard day/Legends|night]] and planned to track down Daal to claim their reward. Daal was eventually captured and detained for questioning by the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Come with me, Daal, I've got a few questions.|A Royal Naboo Security Forces agent, to Daal|<ref name="Signal" />}}
Raymas Daal was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Signal" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Daal was a small-time criminal who found success when he was employed by<ref name="Signal" /> secret agents of<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a corporation that conspired to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] Naboo.<ref name="Signal" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which includes the [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|attack]] on the [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]] [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]], in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the Trade Federation gave Daal [[Currency/Legends|funds]] to hire [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to deactivate Naboo's [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relays]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> including a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]]. The Trade Federation hoped to bring the array down temporarily to allow them to place [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Naboo. It became known on Naboo that Daal had a rich and powerful new backer, leading one group of mercenaries to arrange a meeting with Daal in a [[Kwilaan restaurant|restaurant]] in Kwilaan.<ref name="Signal" />

{{RPGseed}}
[[File:Kwilaan_restaurant.png|thumb|right|250px|The layout of the restaurant where Daal (bottom left) met with the mercenaries]]
En route, Daal correctly believed that [[Security Officer]]s of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were following him, causing him to arrive at the restaurant just as the mercenaries were about to leave. He asked the mercenaries to make the meeting quick on account of his suspicions and offered 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the group to deactivate the sensor array, hiding his Trade Federation backing by claiming that he hoped to smuggle a shipment of rare [[Spice/Legends|spice]] past the array and make greater profits by avoiding taxation. In response to the mercenaries' questions, Daal explained that the attack on the array would need to take place the following [[Standard day/Legends|night]] and that he would be able to detect the array's deactivation and land his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in Kwilaan to provide payment. He was also willing to negotiate with the mercenaries for a fee as high as 10,000 credits.<ref name="Signal" />

As the mercenaries finished their negotiations, three Security Officers entered the restaurant, hoping to take Daal in for questioning out of suspicion of his Trade Federation connections. Their leader, a large Human, pointed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at Daal and asked him to come away to answer his questions. Daal jumped from his seat and ran to the restaurant's rear exit, prompting the agents to fire at him. One of the agents turned their weapon towards the mercenaries, leaving them to deal with the situation. After resolving it, the mercenaries completed the attack on the sensor array, which allowed the Trade Federation to place their jamming satellites. The mercenaries planned to collect their payment from Daal.<ref name="Signal" />
{{Endgame}}

Daal was later captured by the Royal Naboo Security Forces and held for questioning.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Trade Federation would later use the jamming satellites placed during the attack to cut off Naboo's communications while they commenced their invasion of the planet.<ref name="Signal" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Let's make this quick, I think I was followed.|Raymas Daal to the mercenaries|<ref name="Signal" />}}
Daal had impure motives for his actions but had a reputation for being reliable in business dealings. He did not reveal his Trade Federation allegiance to the mercenaries when hiring them, instead claiming that he was trying to boost his own profits. He was willing to answer questions from the mercenaries and negotiate a higher fee for the completion of the job. When confronted by security guards in the restaurant in Kwilaan, Daal did not hesitate to flee the scene. He was a light-skinned Human.<ref name="Signal" />

==Equipment==
Daal wore a light-[[color]]ed [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] under a brown [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], along with a brown [[Hat/Legends|hat]]. He also owned a ship.<ref name="Signal" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Televan-koreyy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|"Signal Interruption" uses a token with an image of Televan Koreyy (pictured) to represent Daal.]]
Raymas Daal was created as a non-playable-character by [[Jesse Decker]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' scenario "[[Signal Interruption]]," which was published on the ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' website on [[August 9]], [[2001]]. Players of the [[roleplaying game]] can control aspects of their characters' interactions with Daal, such as their choice of questions about the attack on the sensor array, the time of the operation, and the layout of the array. The players can also negotiate with Daal to receive as much as 10,000 credits for the assignment.<ref name="Signal" />

"Signal Interruption" suggests that the players can use the existing playable characters from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'': [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Toba]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]. After completing the scenario, players can investigate Daal's Trade Federation connection. The character is represented with a generic mercenary token, which uses an image of<ref name="Signal" /> the character [[Televan Koreyy]]<ref name="Card">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Televan Koreyy}}</ref> from the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
